crossRefs.note: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil. He who keeps his way preserves his soul.
Better is the poor who walks in his integrity, than he who is perverse in his ways, and he is rich.
Solomon said, “You have shown to your servant David my father great loving kindness, because he walked before you in…
There was a man in the land of Uz, whose name was Job. That man was blameless and upright, and one who feared God, and…
To man he said, ‘Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom. To depart from evil is understanding.’ ”
Let integrity and uprightness preserve me, for I wait for you.
Praise Yah! Blessed is the man who fears Yahweh, who delights greatly in his commandments.
This is the end of the matter. All has been heard. Fear God and keep his commandments; for this is the whole duty of…
“My covenant was with him of life and peace; and I gave them to him that he might be reverent toward me; and he was…
The law of truth was in his mouth, and unrighteousness was not found in his lips. He walked with me in peace and…
So the assemblies throughout all Judea, Galilee, and Samaria had peace, and were built up. They were multiplied…
They said, “Cornelius, a centurion, a righteous man and one who fears God, and well spoken of by all the nation of the…
but in every nation he who fears him and works righteousness is acceptable to him.
One who despises his neighbor is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding holds his peace.
I am like one who is a joke to his neighbor, I, who called on God, and he answered. The just, the blameless man is a…
Have mercy on us, Yahweh, have mercy on us, for we have endured much contempt.
Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scoffing of those who are at ease, with the contempt of the proud.
Whoever listens to you listens to me, and whoever rejects you rejects me. Whoever rejects me rejects him who sent me.”
The Pharisees, who were lovers of money, also heard all these things, and they scoffed at him.
Or do you despise the riches of his goodness, forbearance, and patience, not knowing that the goodness of God leads you…
But according to your hardness and unrepentant heart you are treasuring up for yourself wrath in the day of wrath…
For men will be lovers of self, lovers of money, boastful, arrogant, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful…
without natural affection, unforgiving, slanderers, without self-control, fierce, not lovers of good,

translations.web: He who walks in his uprightness fears Yahweh, but he who is perverse in his ways despises him.
translations.bsb: He who walks in uprightness fears the LORD, but the one who is devious in his ways despises Him.
translations.kjv: He that walketh in his uprightness feareth the LORD: but he that is perverse in his ways despiseth
translations.asv: He that walketh in his uprightness feareth Jehovah; But he that is perverse in his ways despiseth him.
